next-action.question: questions/next-action.json
next-action.basis: DISCOVERY.md D18, D43: next eligible action and supporting skills; weighed by the primary agent, never authorization (D6).

assignment.question: questions/assignment.json
assignment.basis: DISCOVERY.md D18, D43, D49: relevance and overlap of proposed agent assignments; advisory as D18 accepted it.

lesson-retention.question: questions/lesson-retention.json
lesson-retention.basis: DISCOVERY.md D18, D43: retention and later relevance of a candidate project lesson; the D21 criteria decide, Jev advises.

model-selection.question: questions/model-selection.json
model-selection.basis: DISCOVERY.md D49: recommends a model and effort from the configured set for the stage; the primary agent may override with a recorded reason (D6).

classify.question: questions/classify.json
classify.basis: DISCOVERY.md D49, D50: one advisory classification over item routing, lesson scope and ticket testability; review-finding disposition excluded (D33).

escalate.question: questions/escalate.json
escalate.basis: DISCOVERY.md D40, D43, D44: Jev's proceed/escalate signal decides whether the human is asked at every human-facing boundary; hard rules (D7, D16/D17, D27/D28) never reach it.

validate.question: questions/validate.json
validate.basis: DISCOVERY.md D41, D47: per-criterion judgment over accepted acceptance criteria and recorded evidence; the gate into review, where an LLM grading its own work is least trustworthy (D38).

next-action.basis: Uncalibrated placeholder (D36, D37): no useful confidence threshold has been established; set conservatively so low-confidence recommendations route to the human. Lowered only by an accepted proposal after replay (D39, D46).

assignment.basis: Uncalibrated placeholder (D36, D37); conservative; lowered only by an accepted proposal after replay (D39, D46).

lesson-retention.basis: Uncalibrated placeholder (D36, D37); conservative; lowered only by an accepted proposal after replay (D39, D46).

model-selection.basis: Uncalibrated placeholder (D37, D49); conservative; lowered only by an accepted proposal after replay (D39, D46).

classify.basis: Uncalibrated placeholder (D37, D50); conservative; lowered only by an accepted proposal after replay (D39, D46).

escalate.basis: Uncalibrated placeholder, conservative per D37 and D45: below-threshold confidence routes to the human, and Jev must be clearly sure before proceed is honoured. Every over-ask is a harness observation (D35); to be lowered by proposal once a recorded corpus supports it (D39, D46). No test asserts this value.

validate.basis: Uncalibrated placeholder (D37, D47): a per-criterion answer below this confidence is treated as insufficient-evidence rather than met; lowered only by an accepted proposal after replay (D39, D46).

actions.name: brainstorm
actions.summary: Investigate an idea or existing problem and produce a specification for human acceptance.

actions.name: plan
actions.summary: Turn an accepted specification into a proposed ticket breakdown of small, independently testable vertical slices.

actions.name: implement
actions.summary: Carry out one assigned ticket at a time, with bounded parallel work inside that ticket.

actions.name: troubleshoot
actions.summary: Diagnose a problem without editing code; remediation goes through an authorized implement action.

actions.name: review
actions.summary: Independently assess a ticket's changes and, at plan end, the integrated result across tickets.

actions.name: wrap
actions.summary: Reconcile outcomes, unresolved todos and lessons, and leave a resume record; never pushes, merges, publishes or destructively cleans up.

actions.name: realign
actions.summary: Human-invoked: reconcile the accepted specification, ticket breakdown and progress with a changed direction and present the result for acceptance; implements nothing.

actions.name: status
actions.summary: Report current workflow progress from the authoritative project records.

actions.name: next
actions.summary: Recommend the next eligible action and relevant supporting skills; a recommendation is not authorization.

actions.name: todo
actions.summary: Record future work outside the active plan; promotion into the plan requires an explicit human decision.

actions.name: learn
actions.summary: Assess and record a candidate project lesson; learning never changes workflow logic.

settings.summary: Create a local commit after a ticket passes checks and independent review.
Retries after the initial attempt for a temporary Jev failure, before asking the human.
Finite timeout for a single Jev request.
Unsuccessful fix attempts on one ticket, counting not-met validation criteria and blocking review findings together, before escalate is asked (D48).
Review always uses a reviewer agent distinct from the implementer; cannot be disabled.
Global ceiling on concurrent stage workers, further bounded per action.
Raw Jev and evidence traces are kept until explicit local cleanup; never auto-deleted, exported or uploaded.
Credentials are never included in evidence sent to Jev.
Full conversation content is excluded from evidence sent to Jev by default.
Full repository content is excluded from evidence sent to Jev by default.
Upper bound on the characters of evidence (task summary, candidates and excerpts) in one packet sent to Jev.
